chunks: He said: Abu Bakr Muhammad ibn Umar al-Ji'abi narrated to us, saying: Abu Abdillah Ja'far ibn Muhammad al-Hasani narrated to me, saying: Ahmad ibn Abd al-Mun'im narrated to us, saying: Abdullah ibn Muhammad al-Fazari narrated to us, from Ja'far ibn Muhammad, from his father, peace be upon them both. And he said: Ja'far ibn Muhammad al-Hasani narrated to me, saying: Ahmad ibn Abd al-Mun'im narrated to us, saying: Amru ibn Shimr narrated to us, from Jabir al-Ju'fi, from Abu Ja'far Muhammad ibn Ali, peace be upon them both, from Jabir ibn Abdillah al-Ansari, who said: The Messenger of God, may God bless him and his family, said to Ali ibn Abi Talib, peace be upon him:

"Shall I not give you glad tidings? Shall I not bestow upon you?" He said: "Yes, O Messenger of God." He said: "Indeed, I and you were created from one clay, and from what remained of it, our followers (Shi'ah) were created. When the Day of Resurrection comes, people will be called by their mothers' names, except your followers, for they will be called by the names of their fathers, confirming the legitimacy of their birth."

key_terms.شِيعَة: Shi'ah, meaning followers/partisans, specifically the devoted followers of Ali and the Prophet's household
key_terms.طِيب مَوْلِد: Purity/legitimacy of birth, indicating that the Shi'ah's lineage is clean and honorable
key_terms.طِينَة: Clay/primordial substance from which the Prophet, Ali, and their followers were created
key_terms.يَوْم الْقِيَامَة: Day of Resurrection, the day of final reckoning

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad say about the creation of Ali and the Shi'ah from one clay?
ai.summary: In this prophetic tradition narrated through two chains, the Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) addresses Ali ibn Abi Talib (AS) with a unique honor: that they were both created from the same divine clay, and their followers (Shi'ah) from the remnant of that clay. On the Day of Judgment, while all people will be called by their mothers' names, the Shi'ah will be distinguished by being called by their fathers' names, indicating the purity and legitimacy of their lineage. This hadith, delivered in a private setting between the Prophet and Ali, would have been understood as affirming a special spiritual bond between the Prophet, Ali, and their devoted followers.

en.mulla-asgharali-m-m-jaffer: 3. He said: Abu Bakr Muhammad ibn Umar al-Ji’abi, reported to me from Abu Abdillah Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Hasani, who reported from Ahmad ibn Abd al-Mon’em, who reported from Abdullah Ibn Muhammad al-Fazari, from Ja’far ibn Muhammad, from his father, peace be upon them all. And he said that Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Hasani reported from Ahmad ibn Abd al-Mon’em, who reported from Amru ibn Shimr, from Jabir al-Jofi, from Abu Ja’far Muhammad ibn ‘Ali, peace be upon him, from Jabir ibn Abdillah al-Ansari, who said: The Prophet, peace be upon him and his progeny, said to ‘Ali ibn Abi Talib, peace be upon him:

"May I not give you glad news? May I not award you?" He said: "Yes, O messenger of Allah." He (i.e. the Prophet) said: "Surely, I and you are created from one clay, and from what remained, our Shi’ahs were created. When the Day of Reckoning will dawn, all people will be called by their mother’s names, except your Shi’ahs, who will be called by the names of their fathers, confirming their legitimacy."
